referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A corporate finance template. A slim dark top bar carries hours and phone; a white navigation row carries the brand, links, and a contact action. A full-bleed office photograph sits under a dark overlay with a left-aligned white promise, supporting copy, and a lime button. A lime callback strip follows, then three bordered service cards with photos, a large statistics band, a split about section, two testimonials, a lime callback form, a client-logo strip, and a dark footer. The typography is a friendly geometric sans. Lime green, white, charcoal, and office photography define the look.
